<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nClaims handlers at three major Keelwater accounts must manually call each supplier to track garage repair progress. This manual process interrupts their workflow, breaks up their day, and distracts them from core claims work, acting as a daily blocker.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Claims handlers at Wexmoor Motor, who report the manual tracking breaks up their day and distracts from core work [i:198bcb654e2dc252].\n- Claims handlers at Callowfield Auto Assurance, who describe the lack of live repair status as a constant, daily blocker [i:4701ef117659ae29].\n- Claims handlers at Pendleford Motor Mutual, who find the need to interrupt their workflow to get updates a real drag [i:4dba64b603f91f1c].\n\n## Evidence\nThe problem has been raised by 3 accounts, across 3 different customer-facing routes, in 3 separate mentions [i:198bcb654e2dc252][i:4701ef117659ae29][i:4dba64b603f91f1c]. The mentions came via sales, account management, and support routes [i:198bcb654e2dc252][i:4701ef117659ae29][i:4dba64b603f91f1c]. The affected accounts represent a total ARR of 3890000.0 GBP [i:198bcb654e2dc252][i:4701ef117659ae29][i:4dba64b603f91f1c]. Wexmoor Motor (ARR 1950000.0 GBP) states they are wrestling with how to track progress without manual calls [i:198bcb654e2dc252]. Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR 1250000.0 GBP) reports constantly phoning suppliers due to no live status [i:4701ef117659ae29]. Pendleford Motor Mutual (ARR 690000.0 GBP) says missing repair updates mean no visibility, forcing workflow interruptions [i:4dba64b603f91f1c].\n\n## Why now\nThe feedback is recent and consistent, with the latest mention on 2026-10-26 [i:198bcb654e2dc252]. All three accounts are approaching renewal: Pendleford Motor Mutual renews on 2027-02-28, Callowfield Auto Assurance on 2027-03-31, and Wexmoor Motor on 2027-06-30 [i:4dba64b603f91f1c][i:4701ef117659ae29][i:198bcb654e2dc252]. In the last 90 days, 0 renewals have occurred, indicating these key accounts are currently in their service period [i:198bcb654e2dc252][i:4701ef117659ae29][i:4dba64b603f91f1c]. The problem is cited as a daily operational pain point across all three, suggesting ongoing and current workflow disruption.",

 ],

 }

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
